frames.narration: The player starts at full health. Its fields are private.
Before a risky fight the manager asks the player to save.
The player packs its own state into a Snapshot. No one else ever sees how.
The manager just stores it on a stack. It cannot open it.
The fight goes badly. The player is hurt and has gained a level.
Load checkpoint. The manager hands the snapshot back to the player.
The player reads its own snapshot and puts itself back. Its internals stayed private the whole time.
